target: The manuscript text, organization, and technical expression represented by the fixed target LaTeX source snapshot.
aggregation: Overall Writing Quality is a direct judgment. Do not calculate an average or weighted total, or cap it using auxiliary findings.
shared_rules: The same canonical anchors apply to human and model ratings of the same source version and declared scope; record their different reading representations.
Normal stylistic variation and minor copyediting preferences do not prevent a 5. Use the anchors without forcing a balanced score distribution.
Evaluate communication, not novelty, acceptance merit, external factual truth, scientific correctness, source-code elegance, or preferred LaTeX formatting.
Do not require a fixed section sequence, empirical experiment, figure, table, or equation. Apply the criteria to the paper type and stated purpose.
Technical expression includes definitions, concepts, procedures and analysis, so all five core dimensions apply even when there are no figures or equations. No core N/A is allowed.
Use uncertain for an affected dimension when missing evidence or a preprocessing/presentation limitation prevents a defensible judgment; do not turn missing evidence into a low score.
A confirmed missing or placeholder source passage is a source defect. A parser failure on an existing file or an input truncation is a pipeline limitation. Distinguish their causes.
Do not claim visual inspection of an image from its filename or caption. Mark an affected judgment uncertain if unsupplied visual content is indispensable.
PDF rendering quality and conference-version differences are separate auxiliary findings. Neither causes an automatic core-score penalty.
Review the declared primary scope and relevant explicitly supplied supporting material. A legitimately available appendix may carry details; not all detail must be repeated in the main text.
If transport or context truncation prevents a full-scope run, do not publish whole-paper final scores. Return an incomplete assessment with uncertain core scores and arrange a complete-coverage run.

dimensions.label: Language Clarity & Fluency
dimensions.definition: Assess sentence-level comprehensibility, wording, grammar and clear use of terminology in the target manuscript. Scientific truth and preference for a particular English style are outside this dimension.

scale.1: Most of the relevant prose is unintelligible or too ambiguous to recover its meaning.
scale.2: Frequent severe wording or grammatical problems obscure important meanings across substantial passages.
scale.3: Recurring unclear, ambiguous or awkward passages require substantial rereading or reader reconstruction, although the main meanings can be recovered.
scale.4: A few localized wording, grammar or terminology problems require minor clarification; the main meanings remain readily understandable.
scale.5: The prose is clear and fluent, with sufficiently precise wording for its purpose. Harmless stylistic differences or minor copyediting preferences do not reduce this score.

dimensions.definition_zh: 评价目标论文句子的可理解性、措辞、语法和术语表达；不评价科学事实真伪，也不因偏好某种英文风格扣分。

scale_zh.1: 大部分相关文字无法理解，或含义模糊到难以还原。
scale_zh.2: 频繁且严重的措辞或语法问题，遮蔽多个重要段落的含义。
scale_zh.3: 反复出现含混或不自然的表述，需明显重读或推断，但主要含义仍可还原。
scale_zh.4: 少量局部措辞、语法或术语问题需要澄清，主要含义仍易于理解。
scale_zh.5: 表达清楚、流畅，措辞足以准确传达目的；无碍理解的风格差异或轻微润色偏好不扣分。

dimensions.label: Coherence & Logical Flow
dimensions.definition: Assess how sentences, paragraphs, sections, claims and supporting explanations connect within the target version. Judge whether the communicated argument can be followed, not whether its scientific claims are true.

scale.1: The manuscript lacks a recoverable main line of exposition; most connections cannot be followed.
scale.2: Major disconnections, unexplained jumps or internal contradictions block understanding of important parts of the exposition.
scale.3: Repeated weak transitions, unexplained dependencies, repetition or inconsistent exposition require the reader to reconstruct important connections.
scale.4: The exposition is followable, with a few local jumps, repetitions or weak transitions that need minor revision.
scale.5: Ideas and supporting explanations progress coherently; the reader can follow the main line without supplying missing connections.

dimensions.definition_zh: 评价目标版本句子、段落、章节、论点和支撑解释之间的联系；判断读者能否跟随论述，而非科学结论是否正确。

scale_zh.1: 缺少可还原的主要论述线索，大部分联系无法跟随。
scale_zh.2: 严重脱节、无解释跳跃或内部矛盾妨碍理解重要论述。
scale_zh.3: 反复出现衔接不足、悬空依赖、重复或表述不一致，需要读者重建重要联系。
scale_zh.4: 论述可以跟随，存在少量局部跳跃、重复或衔接不足，需要轻微修订。
scale_zh.5: 思想与支撑解释展开连贯，读者无需自行补足缺失联系即可跟随主线。

dimensions.label: Structural Completeness
dimensions.definition: Assess whether the manuscript supplies a complete account for its paper type, stated aims and own content dependencies. Do not assess coverage of the conference version or demand a particular section template.

scale.1: The target account is severely fragmented, with most essential narrative content demonstrably absent or replaced by placeholders.
scale.2: Major missing, truncated or unfinished parts prevent understanding of the problem, approach, analysis or other essential account appropriate to this paper.
scale.3: Several substantive narrative gaps or dangling dependencies leave parts incomplete, although the central account can still be reconstructed.
scale.4: The principal account is complete; a few local omissions or organizational gaps need minor clarification.
scale.5: The manuscript presents a complete, navigable account for its stated scope and paper type, without material narrative gaps. Valid detail in supplied supporting material is acceptable.

dimensions.definition_zh: 相对于论文类型、明确目标和自身内容依赖，评价论述是否完整；不要求覆盖会议版内容，也不强制特定章节模板。

scale_zh.1: 论述严重残缺，大部分关键叙述内容已证实缺失或仍是占位内容。
scale_zh.2: 重要部分缺失、截断或未完成，妨碍理解该类型论文的核心问题、方法、分析或其他必要论述。
scale_zh.3: 多个实质叙述缺口或悬空依赖使部分内容不完整，但仍可还原中心论述。
scale_zh.4: 主要论述完整，仅有少量局部遗漏或组织缺口需澄清。
scale_zh.5: 就声明范围和论文类型而言，论述完整且易于定位，没有实质叙述缺口；细节合理放在已提供的支持材料中可以接受。

dimensions.label: Technical Expression & Referential Clarity
dimensions.definition: Assess the clarity of concepts, definitions, symbols, methods, steps, mathematical explanations, source-readable tables, captions and cross-references. This is communication of technical material, not proof of correctness or evaluation of unsupplied image pixels.

scale.1: Most of the essential technical account cannot be interpreted because its expressions, definitions or referential links are missing or uninterpretable.
scale.2: Major undefined concepts or symbols, ambiguous steps or broken explanatory dependencies prevent understanding of important technical content.
scale.3: Recurring insufficient definitions, ambiguous notation, unclear captions or unexplained links require substantial reader inference.
scale.4: The key technical account is understandable; a few local definitions, explanations or referential links need clarification.
scale.5: Technical concepts and relevant expressions are sufficiently defined and explained; the supplied methods, notation and referential links support clear understanding within the declared scope.

dimensions.label_zh: 技术表达与引用指向清晰度
dimensions.definition_zh: 评价概念、定义、符号、方法步骤、数学说明、源码可读的表格、图表说明和交叉引用；不证明科学正确性，也不评价未提供的图片像素。

scale_zh.1: 大部分必要技术内容因表达、定义或指向联系缺失或不可解读而无法理解。
scale_zh.2: 重要概念或符号未定义、步骤含混或解释依赖断裂，妨碍理解关键技术内容。
scale_zh.3: 反复出现定义不足、符号含混、说明不清或关联未解释，需要大量读者推断。
scale_zh.4: 关键技术论述可以理解，少量局部定义、解释或指向联系需要澄清。
scale_zh.5: 技术概念及相关表达定义和说明充分，已提供的方法、符号及指向联系支持理解声明范围内的内容。

dimensions.label: Overall Writing Quality
dimensions.definition: Directly judge the target manuscript as clear, coherent and sufficiently complete scientific writing suitable for use as an academic-writing research document. Do not average component scores or require scientific novelty, perfect typesetting or agreement with another version.

scale.1: The manuscript is largely unusable as an understandable scientific account because of pervasive writing or confirmed content-completeness problems.
scale.2: Serious writing or content-completeness problems require substantial rewriting or restoration before the main account is understandable.
scale.3: The main account is usable, but noticeable writing or narrative problems require substantial reader reconstruction or meaningful revision.
scale.4: The manuscript is clear and usable overall, with localized writing issues needing minor revision.
scale.5: The manuscript communicates a clear, coherent and sufficiently complete scientific account for its stated purpose and scope. Minor stylistic preferences do not reduce this score.

dimensions.definition_zh: 直接评价目标论文是否清楚、连贯且足够完整，能作为学术写作研究材料；不计算分项平均，也不要求创新性、完美排版或与另一版本一致。

scale_zh.1: 普遍的写作问题或已证实的内容缺失，使论文大部分无法作为可理解的科学论述使用。
scale_zh.2: 严重写作或内容完整性问题，需要大量重写或恢复，才能理解主要论述。
scale_zh.3: 主要论述基本可用，但明显写作或叙述问题需要读者大量推断或进行实质修订。
scale_zh.4: 论文总体清楚可用，局部写作问题需要轻微修订。
scale_zh.5: 就其明确目的和范围，论文传达清楚、连贯且足够完整的科学论述；轻微风格偏好不扣分。

auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.requires: Actual observation of the target rendered PDF, identified by its hash.

scale.1: Most displayed content cannot be read normally.
scale.2: Multiple important displayed parts are difficult or impossible to read.
scale.3: Localized rendering defects impede reading of some displayed content.
scale.4: Minor visual defects do not materially impede reading.
scale.5: The inspected target PDF is visually intact and legible.

auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.source_only_rule: Return not_assessed with a null score and no issue codes; do not infer rendering quality from LaTeX.
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.core_interpretation: If display defects block a human core judgment, consult a readable same-source representation; otherwise mark the affected core judgment uncertain rather than penalizing source writing.
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.label: PDF Visual Integrity & Legibility
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.label_zh: PDF 视觉完整性与可读性
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.definition: Optional: rate only the displayed target PDF. This does not contribute to writing scores or completion.
auxiliary_pdf_visual_integrity.definition_zh: 选填：仅评价显示的目标 PDF；不计入写作评分，也不影响完成状态。

scale_zh.1: 大部分显示内容无法正常阅读。
scale_zh.2: 多处重要显示内容难以或无法阅读。
scale_zh.3: 局部渲染缺陷影响部分内容阅读。
scale_zh.4: 轻微视觉缺陷，不明显影响阅读。
scale_zh.5: 检查的目标 PDF 视觉完整、清晰可读。

scope.en: Rate the writing represented by the selected arXiv LaTeX source. The PDF is a reading aid; assess visual defects separately.
scope.zh: 评价选定 arXiv LaTeX 源码中的写作内容。PDF 用于辅助阅读；视觉缺陷单独检查。

version_difference_flags.label: Methods, experiments, results or conclusions differ
version_difference_flags.label_zh: 方法、实验、结果或结论不同
